steps: Download, print, and fill out the 'Existing Member' section of the Alltrust Refer A Friend form.
Give the form to the friend/family member being referred.
The new member opens an Alltrust checking account with a Mastercard Debit Card.
The new member uses the debit card at least 10 times (signature transactions) within 60 days.
After 90 days, if all requirements are fulfilled, $25 is deposited into each party's Regular Savings account.
timing: $25 deposited into the referrer's Regular Savings account after 90 days if the new member fulfills all requirements.
when_cash_arrives: $25 deposited into the referrer's Regular Savings account after 90 days if the new member fulfills all requirements. Terms impose a fixed waiting period after the friend's account opens - nothing arrives before that date.
maximize: Refer early and have your friend complete ALL qualifying activity in the first days of the window - late qualification pushes the fixed payout date even further out.
Both accounts must stay open and in good standing through the entire wait - early closure forfeits the bonus.
Structural reason it cannot be faster: the program's terms lock payout to a fixed date (60-120 days out) regardless of how fast your friend qualifies.
